name: pstack_loop
obligation: Register a pstack_loop tool with action arm, stop, status, or list and optional mode, prompt, intervalSeconds, maxFires, watchArgv, and id.
Default mode to interval, intervalSeconds to 1800, and maxFires to 50 when arming via the tool.
Throw "prompt required to arm" when action=arm is called without a prompt.
Throw "action must be arm|stop|status|list" for an unknown action.
Throw "mode must be interval|settle|watcher|dynamic" for an invalid mode.
Reject the watchCommand parameter and require watchArgv as an argv array instead of a bash -lc string.
Constrain intervalSeconds to 5 through 86400 and maxFires to 1 through 500 in the tool schema.
Arm the interval timer at arm time and re-arm it after each interval fire.
Arm the settle timer only on agent_settled for settle and dynamic modes.
Fire a watcher-mode loop exactly once when watchArgv exits and never re-arm it.
Re-arm the watcher after each fire in dynamic mode while still armed and below maxFires.
Coalesce a dynamic fire when the previous fire is within the 2500 ms window.
Skip arming the settle timer on agent_settled when the previous fire is within the coalesce window.
Stop the loop when the next fire would exceed maxFires.
Never fire a disarmed loop.
Deliver each fire as a follow-up message prefixed [pstack_loop <id> fire <n>/<max> reason=<reason>] followed by the prompt.
Reset the prompt to the base prompt after each fire so watcher output is injected only once.
Run watchArgv as command plus args via pi.exec with a 24-hour timeout and skip arming when watchArgv[0] starts with a dash.
Fire reason watcher on a zero watchArgv exit code, watcher-error on a nonzero exit code, and abort the running watcher when the loop stops.
Require watchArgv for mode=watcher and reject a watchArgv[0] that is empty or starts with a dash.
Clear every loop and SIGTERM each running watcher on session_shutdown.
Return one formatted row per loop for status and list, and stop the named loop or all loops for action=stop.

name: /pstack-loop
obligation: Arm an interval loop from /pstack-loop <seconds> <prompt> with maxFires 100 and a minimum interval of 5 seconds.

name: /pstack-loop
obligation: Treat /pstack-loop status, list, stop [id], and off as status and stop forms.

name: pstack_worktree
obligation: Register a pstack_worktree tool with action create, list, remove, prune, or cleanup and optional name and base.
Reject a worktree name that is empty, starts with a dash, contains .. or path separators or NUL, or uses characters outside [A-Za-z0-9._@+=,-].
Reject a base ref that is empty, starts with a dash, contains .. or whitespace or NUL, or uses characters outside [A-Za-z0-9._/~^+-].
Create the worktree under .pstack-worktrees/<slug> on branch pstack/<slug> from the base ref with HEAD as the default base.
Refuse to create when 12 or more pstack worktrees already exist, with a session-cap error.
Default the slug to pstack-<Date.now()> when create is called without a name.
Surface a git worktree add failure as Error "git worktree add failed: <message>".
List worktrees via git worktree list --porcelain and report the pstack-managed count against the 12 cap.
Prune via git worktree prune -v.
Remove a worktree with git worktree remove --force, falling back to a non-force remove.
Require a name for remove and reject an unknown action with the create|list|remove|prune|cleanup set.
Skip shutdown cleanup for any worktree whose pstack child-session jsonl was touched in the last 30 minutes.
Remove on shutdown only when the worktree is clean and its HEAD is an ancestor of main HEAD or its branch is listed as merged.
Shutdown cleanup must remove only worktrees that are clean, merged, and free of recent child sessions, and must skip untracked-only scratch worktrees as unsafe.
Run session_shutdown cleanup against the project working directory and swallow cleanup errors so shutdown is never blocked.

name: pstack_ship
obligation: Register a pstack_ship tool with action view, merge, stack-status, or gate-check and optional pr, stackPrs, and mergeMethod.
Report already merged as a gate problem when mergedAt is set.
Report state=<state> as a gate problem for any state other than OPEN.
Report a gate problem when mergeStateStatus is UNSTABLE, DIRTY, DRAFT, BLOCKED, or BEHIND.
Report a gate problem for a check whose conclusion is FAILURE, CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT, ERROR, or ACTION_REQUIRED.
Report a gate problem for a check with no conclusion whose status is PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, or QUEUED.
Report a gate problem when reviewDecision is CHANGES_REQUESTED or REVIEW_REQUIRED.
Treat a PR view with no blocking fields as an empty problem list.
Report every gate problem in view order and uppercase check conclusions while naming unnamed checks with a question mark.
Fail closed in assertMergeGates on a nonzero gh pr view exit or on invalid gh JSON.
Run the gate check before merging and merge with gh pr merge using --squash by default.
Map mergeMethod merge to --merge, rebase to --rebase, and anything else to --squash.
Throw "gh pr merge failed (fail closed)" when the merge command exits nonzero.
Return gate-check PASS plus the JSON PR view for action=gate-check.
Require pr for view, merge, and gate-check and reject an unknown action with the view|merge|stack-status|gate-check set.
Require at least one PR for stack-status via stackPrs or pr.
Implement stack-status as a frontier watcher with ADVANCE and COMPLETE semantics rather than a sequential per-PR view.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/shipping-frontier.test.ts@reports ADVANCE when the frontier is merge-ready

name: pstack_babysit
obligation: Register a pstack_babysit tool with required pr and optional statusOnly, pretty, recipeId, and armLoopHint.
Default the recipe to watch-pr-drive and force watch-pr-status when statusOnly is true.
Reject an unknown recipeId with an error listing the known recipes.
Build the watch-pr-status recipe as the bundled watch-pr script plus the PR and a --status-only flag.
Build the watch-pr-drive recipe as the bundled watch-pr script plus the PR, stripping a leading hash.
Throw for an unknown watch recipe.
Reject an empty, dash-leading, or whitespace-containing PR argument for watchArgv.
Execute the bundled watch-pr script through its Bun shebang runtime rather than through bash.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/heartbeat-coalesce.test.ts@no babysit recipe executes the bundled watcher through bash

obligation: Ship the watch-pr and worktree-audit.sh scripts with executable mode 0755 so direct-exec instructions work.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/script-runtime-contract.test.ts@bundled scripts keep the executable bit upstream ships

obligation: Return a loopArm payload of action arm, mode dynamic, intervalSeconds 120, maxFires 40, the materialized watchArgv, and a frontier prompt.
Include the loopArm hint by default and omit it when armLoopHint is false.
Build the gh-checks-watch recipe as gh pr checks <pr> --watch.
Build the gh-view-json recipe as gh pr view <pr> --json state,mergeStateStatus,statusCheckRollup,reviewDecision.
Run gh-checks-watch with a one-hour timeout and gh-view-json with a 60-second timeout.
Fall back to a one-shot gh pr view when the bundled watch-pr script is absent and the recipe is drive or status.
Wire a queued-stack watch mode with --queued-stack and --stack-prs for stacked PR babysitting.

name: /pstack-gates
obligation: Register a /pstack-gates command taking a single PR argument.
Evaluate the same blocking criteria as pstack_ship gate-check so /pstack-gates cannot pass a PR that merge would block.
verification: test@tests/layers/01-unit/gates-command.test.ts@fails a PR that the merge gate would block

obligation: Show a usage error when no PR is supplied.
Fail closed with an error notification when gh pr view fails or returns invalid JSON.
Notify an error and send a do-not-ship follow-up message when any gate problem is found.
Notify pass and send a still-run-unslop follow-up message when no gate problem is found.
